break_invitation.speaker: liam
break_invitation.text: Can we go home for a little while?

break_invitation.speaker: liam
break_invitation.text: My feet are. And I'm hungry.

break_invitation.speaker: caelan
break_invitation.text: Of course. We've been walking quite a bit.

break_invitation.speaker: caelan
break_invitation.text: We can collect it on the way. If the handle's ready, you can take it home.

break_invitation.speaker: liam
break_invitation.text: I want to try the stairs before Mum sees it.

break_invitation.speaker: tomas
break_invitation.text: We can look at them after you've had something to eat.

collect_frame.speaker: mira
collect_frame.text: Back already? How did you get on?

collect_frame.speaker: liam
collect_frame.text: We saw Elira's lantern. She's had it a long time.

collect_frame.speaker: mira
collect_frame.text: She looks after it. Yours is ready to take home, if that's where you're going.

collect_frame.speaker: liam
collect_frame.text: Did the handle stay where we put it?

collect_frame.speaker: mira
collect_frame.text: It did. I've secured it and checked the joins.

collect_frame.speaker: liam
collect_frame.text: Can I carry it this time?

collect_frame.speaker: mira
collect_frame.text: Try it. Keep it clear of the ground, and give yourself room when you turn.

collect_frame.speaker: tomas
collect_frame.text: I'll mind the other side.

collect_frame.speaker: caelan
collect_frame.text: Would you like me to take the drawing?

collect_frame.speaker: liam
collect_frame.text: Don't fold it.

collect_frame.speaker: caelan
collect_frame.text: I can keep it flat in my satchel.

collect_frame.speaker: liam
collect_frame.text: All right. Is this the paper for the sides?

collect_frame.speaker: mira
collect_frame.text: Yes. Try your design on a spare piece first. Leave the covering loose until you're happy with it.

collect_frame.speaker: liam
collect_frame.text: I want the stairs to go round here.

collect_frame.speaker: mira
collect_frame.text: Then lay the paper beside your drawing and see how much room you have.

collect_frame.speaker: tomas
collect_frame.text: The drawing's got quite a few steps.

collect_frame.speaker: liam
collect_frame.text: I know how many.

collect_frame.speaker: mira
collect_frame.text: You can change your mind when you try them. That's what the spare piece is for.

collect_frame.speaker: caelan
collect_frame.text: I'll take the loose sheets with the drawing.

collect_frame.speaker: liam
collect_frame.text: Please don't put anything on top.

collect_frame.speaker: caelan
collect_frame.text: I won't.

collect_frame.speaker: mira
collect_frame.text: Ready, Liam? You can lift it now.

home_welcome.speaker: liam_father
home_welcome.text: There you are. Have you eaten anything since you left?

home_welcome.speaker: liam
home_welcome.text: We went to the mill.

home_welcome.speaker: liam_father
home_welcome.text: That doesn't answer me.

home_welcome.speaker: tomas
home_welcome.text: (amused) He asked about buns.

home_welcome.speaker: liam
home_welcome.text: There weren't any there.

home_welcome.speaker: liam_father
home_welcome.text: Then you've come to the right place for bread, at least. Is that your lantern?

home_welcome.speaker: liam
home_welcome.text: The frame. We haven't put the paper on.

home_welcome.speaker: liam_father
home_welcome.text: I see. It's taller than I expected.

home_welcome.speaker: liam
home_welcome.text: It's a tower.

home_welcome.speaker: liam_father
home_welcome.text: So it is. Mind the corner as you come past.

home_welcome.speaker: caelan
home_welcome.text: Mira helped him make it. The drawing and paper are with me.

home_welcome.speaker: liam_father
home_welcome.text: Thank you, both of you. There's room to put them down here.

home_welcome.speaker: liam
home_welcome.text: Can I leave the frame where Daisy won't knock it?

home_welcome.speaker: liam_father
home_welcome.text: On the table. Set it well back from the edge, and we'll keep the food at this end.

home_welcome.speaker: tomas
home_welcome.text: Your mother's still at the school?

home_welcome.speaker: liam_father
home_welcome.text: She'll still be at the school. I'll hear all about the afternoon when she's back.

home_welcome.speaker: liam
home_welcome.text: Ada got paste on her sleeve.

home_welcome.speaker: liam_father
home_welcome.text: Then perhaps I'll hear about that, too.

home_welcome.speaker: caelan
home_welcome.text: She knew we might stop at some of the preparations.

home_welcome.speaker: liam_father
home_welcome.text: Good. Have a break before you go anywhere else. You look ready for one.

home_welcome.speaker: liam
home_welcome.text: Can you keep the paper flat?

home_welcome.speaker: caelan
home_welcome.text: Yes. Let's put everything down carefully.

snack.speaker: liam_father
snack.text: There. Bread and something to drink. You two help yourselves as well.

snack.speaker: liam
snack.text: You could hear it before we got there. Halden showed us where to stand.

snack.speaker: liam
snack.text: Yes. The water doesn't go in the flour.

snack.speaker: tomas
snack.text: He wanted to know what it could grind.

snack.speaker: liam
snack.text: I wasn't going to put anything in.

snack.speaker: caelan
snack.text: He asked first. Halden was happy to let us look.

snack.speaker: liam_father
snack.text: Then I'm glad you went. Finish that bite before you tell me the rest.

snack.speaker: liam_father
snack.text: There's more bread if you'd like it, Tomas.

snack.speaker: liam_father
snack.text: Help yourselves. Yours goes on the table when you're done, Liam.

snack.speaker: caelan
snack.text: There's time to sit a little longer, Liam.

snack.speaker: liam
snack.text: I want to try the paper now. My feet don't have to do anything for that.

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: It fitted before.

paper_practice.speaker: tomas
paper_practice.text: On the drawing?

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: Yes. This bit's too small.

paper_practice.speaker: caelan
paper_practice.text: Show me where you want the last step.

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: There. But then there's no room for the window.

paper_practice.speaker: tomas
paper_practice.text: Could the stairs turn sooner?

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: They're meant to go all the way round.

paper_practice.speaker: caelan
paper_practice.text: Would another piece underneath help you try it?

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: Don't draw it for me.

paper_practice.speaker: caelan
paper_practice.text: I won't. Show me where to hold it.

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: This corner. It's moving when I rub that bit.

paper_practice.speaker: liam_father
paper_practice.text: You can use a fresh piece. There's no need to rub through this one.

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: But I got the top right.

paper_practice.speaker: caelan
paper_practice.text: Keep it beside you, then. You can look at the top while you try the stairs again.

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: (frustrated) I know what I want it to look like.

paper_practice.speaker: tomas
paper_practice.text: I know. The drawing helped Mira see it, didn't it?

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: Yes.

paper_practice.speaker: tomas
paper_practice.text: Could you try a few bigger steps on this piece? Just to see.

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: There wouldn't be as many.

paper_practice.speaker: tomas
paper_practice.text: You'd have room for the window.

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: Maybe. Can I keep the other piece, too?

paper_practice.speaker: liam_father
paper_practice.text: Of course. I'll keep the food away from it.

paper_practice.speaker: caelan
paper_practice.text: I'm holding this corner. Tell me when you want to move it.

paper_practice.speaker: liam
paper_practice.text: All right. Don't let go yet.

brothers.speaker: tomas
brothers.text: (quietly) I thought Elira would be glad not to carry it.

brothers.speaker: tomas
brothers.text: Yes. I thought I was helping.

brothers.speaker: tomas
brothers.text: But she still wanted to carry it herself.

brothers.speaker: caelan
brothers.text: She told you. You said all right.

brothers.speaker: tomas
brothers.text: I nearly tried to persuade her.

brothers.speaker: tomas
brothers.text: So am I. I can mind the door.

brothers.speaker: caelan
brothers.text: I wasn't sure what to say when she went quiet.

brothers.speaker: liam
brothers.text: Caelan? Can you look at this bit?

brothers.speaker: liam
brothers.text: There's room for the window now. I haven't decided about the bottom.

liam_questions.speaker: liam
liam_questions.text: Why does Elira take the lantern for her husband?

liam_questions.speaker: caelan
liam_questions.text: To remember him when everyone gathers.

liam_questions.speaker: liam
liam_questions.text: She already remembers him.

liam_questions.speaker: caelan
liam_questions.text: She does. Taking it lets her do that with other people.

liam_questions.speaker: liam
liam_questions.text: Is that why it's called Returning Light?

liam_questions.speaker: caelan
liam_questions.text: We believe the life in us returns to the gods when we die. The festival is part of how we remember that.

liam_questions.speaker: liam
liam_questions.text: What comes back?

liam_questions.speaker: tomas
liam_questions.text: The life. That's what Caelan means by returning.

liam_questions.speaker: liam
liam_questions.text: But Elira still wanted him here.

liam_questions.speaker: caelan
liam_questions.text: Yes. You heard how much she misses him.

liam_questions.speaker: liam
liam_questions.text: I liked when she was laughing.

liam_questions.speaker: tomas
liam_questions.text: So did I.

liam_questions.speaker: liam
liam_questions.text: Can we ask Serene about it?

liam_questions.speaker: caelan
liam_questions.text: Of course. She'll give you time to ask.

liam_questions.speaker: liam_father
liam_questions.text: If you're going up to the sanctuary, leave the frame here. I'll keep it safe.

liam_questions.speaker: liam
liam_questions.text: And the drawing. I want to use that piece again.

liam_questions.speaker: liam_father
liam_questions.text: All of it stays together on the table.

liam_questions.speaker: caelan
liam_questions.text: Would you like some more to drink before we go?

liam_questions.speaker: liam
liam_questions.text: No, thank you. I'm ready.

liam_questions.speaker: tomas
liam_questions.text: Thank you for the bread.

liam_questions.speaker: liam_father
liam_questions.text: You're welcome. Stay together, you three.

liam_questions.speaker: liam
liam_questions.text: We will. Don't let Daisy have the paper.

liam_questions.speaker: liam_father
liam_questions.text: I'll keep an eye on it. Go and have your talk.

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: serene
sanctuary_welcome.text: Hello, you three. Have you come to show me the lantern?

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: liam
sanctuary_welcome.text: It's at home. The frame's finished, but the paper isn't.

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: serene
sanctuary_welcome.text: Then I shall look forward to seeing it when you're ready.

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: caelan
sanctuary_welcome.text: Liam had some questions after our visit to Elira.

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: liam
sanctuary_welcome.text: Yes. She told us how her husband got the song wrong.

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: serene
sanctuary_welcome.text: (smiling) That sounds like a conversation worth having.

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: liam
sanctuary_welcome.text: Am I keeping you from that?

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: serene
sanctuary_welcome.text: These papers can wait a little. Tell me what you wanted to ask.

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: liam
sanctuary_welcome.text: Caelan said the life goes back to the gods.

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: liam
sanctuary_welcome.text: I don't think I understood it.

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: serene
sanctuary_welcome.text: All right. We can take our time.

sanctuary_welcome.speaker: tomas
sanctuary_welcome.text: We've had something to eat, too.

returning_life.speaker: liam
returning_life.text: What part of Elira's husband comes back?

returning_life.speaker: serene
returning_life.text: We speak of the life that was in him. The life in all of us.

returning_life.speaker: liam
returning_life.text: Like the life in me?

returning_life.speaker: serene
returning_life.text: Yes. We believe it returns to the gods when we die.

returning_life.speaker: liam
returning_life.text: Does any of it go inside the lantern?

returning_life.speaker: serene
returning_life.text: No, love. It's still a lamp. Elira carries it to remember her husband.

returning_life.speaker: liam
returning_life.text: Why does she light it, then?

returning_life.speaker: serene
returning_life.text: It gives her something to carry when we gather. She can stand with the people who remember him, and with people who want to keep her company.

returning_life.speaker: liam
returning_life.text: Even if they didn't know him?

returning_life.speaker: serene
returning_life.text: Yes. You hadn't heard him sing, had you?

returning_life.speaker: liam
returning_life.text: No. I wanted to.

returning_life.speaker: serene
returning_life.text: You listened when she told you about him.

returning_life.speaker: liam
returning_life.text: He put a garden gate in it.

returning_life.speaker: tomas
returning_life.text: And sang it louder when she tried to tell him.

returning_life.speaker: serene
returning_life.text: (laughing softly) Poor Elira. I can imagine her face.

returning_life.speaker: liam
returning_life.text: She laughed, too. And then she got quiet.

returning_life.speaker: serene
returning_life.text: You can remember something funny and wish the person were here to laugh with you.

returning_life.speaker: liam
returning_life.text: Does she still believe what you said? About the gods?

returning_life.speaker: serene
returning_life.text: I believe she does.

returning_life.speaker: liam
returning_life.text: But she still wants him here.

returning_life.speaker: serene
returning_life.text: Of course. She misses sharing her days with him. Her faith doesn't stop her missing that.

remembering.speaker: liam
remembering.text: Is the whole festival for people who've died?

remembering.speaker: serene
remembering.text: Remembering them is part of it. So is being here together.

remembering.speaker: liam
remembering.text: Like taking bread to the Venns?

remembering.speaker: serene
remembering.text: Yes. They're still part of the celebration if they spend the evening at home.

remembering.speaker: caelan
remembering.text: Their mother said she'd speak to you when they know what they can manage.

remembering.speaker: serene
remembering.text: Then we'll wait to hear from her. I'm glad you visited.

remembering.speaker: tomas
remembering.text: They've been choosing colors for a decoration.

remembering.speaker: liam
remembering.text: Yellow at both ends. Their mum's doing the ties.

remembering.speaker: liam
remembering.text: What if someone doesn't want to sing?

remembering.speaker: serene
remembering.text: They can listen. You don't have to do every part of the evening.

remembering.speaker: liam
remembering.text: Elira said some people just listen.

remembering.speaker: liam
remembering.text: I was mostly thinking about the food before.

remembering.speaker: serene
remembering.text: Are you still looking forward to it?

remembering.speaker: liam
remembering.text: I want to hear Elira sing. She said we could find her.

remembering.speaker: serene
remembering.text: Then I think she'll be glad to see you.

sanctuary_close.speaker: serene
sanctuary_close.text: Was there something else you wanted to ask?

sanctuary_close.speaker: liam
sanctuary_close.text: I don't think so. Not yet.

sanctuary_close.speaker: serene
sanctuary_close.text: You can ask another time if you think of something.

sanctuary_close.speaker: liam
sanctuary_close.text: I thought Elira might not want to come if it made her sad.

sanctuary_close.speaker: serene
sanctuary_close.text: She can decide what she wants to do. We can make sure she's welcome when she comes.

sanctuary_close.speaker: tomas
sanctuary_close.text: I'm going to mind her door when she brings the lantern out.

sanctuary_close.speaker: serene
sanctuary_close.text: Good. That sounds useful.

sanctuary_close.speaker: caelan
sanctuary_close.text: Thank you for giving us the time.

sanctuary_close.speaker: serene
sanctuary_close.text: I'm glad you brought him. How did the work at Mira's go?

sanctuary_close.speaker: liam
sanctuary_close.text: It's still a tower. We had to change the roof a bit.

sanctuary_close.speaker: tomas
sanctuary_close.text: And leave somewhere for the heat to go.

sanctuary_close.speaker: liam
sanctuary_close.text: I know about that now. The stairs are the hard part.

sanctuary_close.speaker: serene
sanctuary_close.text: Are they coming along?

sanctuary_close.speaker: liam
sanctuary_close.text: I've tried them on a spare piece. There's room for the window.

sanctuary_close.speaker: serene
sanctuary_close.text: Then you've made some progress today.

sanctuary_close.speaker: liam
sanctuary_close.text: (pleased) I tied one of the corners myself.

sanctuary_close.speaker: serene
sanctuary_close.text: You'll have to show me when it's finished.

sanctuary_close.speaker: liam
sanctuary_close.text: I will. And Elira. And Mum hasn't seen it yet.

sanctuary_close.speaker: caelan
sanctuary_close.text: It's safe at home. We can think about the rest when you're ready.

sanctuary_close.speaker: liam
sanctuary_close.text: All right. Thank you, Serene.

sanctuary_close.speaker: serene
sanctuary_close.text: You're very welcome, Liam.

rest_tomas_waiting.speaker: tomas
rest_tomas_waiting.text: We can take our time. Liam's had quite a walk.

rest_liam_waiting.speaker: liam
rest_liam_waiting.text: I'd like to go home for a little while.

mira_before_collection.speaker: mira
mira_before_collection.text: The handle's secured. Your frame and drawing are here when you're ready, Liam.

mira_after_collection.speaker: mira
mira_after_collection.text: Try the design on a spare piece before you attach the covering. You've got time to see what fits.

father_before_break.speaker: liam_father
father_before_break.text: Come in, all three of you. There's room to put things down and have a rest.

father_during_break.speaker: liam_father
father_during_break.text: Keep the piece you like beside you. You can look at it while you try the next one.

father_after_break.speaker: liam_father
father_after_break.text: The frame and papers are safe together here. I'll keep an eye on them.

mother_during_rest.speaker: liam_mother
mother_during_rest.text: Come and find me when you're ready to show me your lantern, love.

paper_waiting.speaker: liam
paper_waiting.text: I want the stairs to fit without covering the window.

serene_before_visit.speaker: serene
serene_before_visit.text: Hello, you three. Come and speak with me when you're ready.

serene_during_visit.speaker: serene
serene_during_visit.text: Take your time, Liam. Tell me what you wanted to ask.

serene_after_visit.speaker: serene
serene_after_visit.text: I'm glad you came to talk. I'll look forward to seeing the finished lantern.

rest_after.speaker: liam
rest_after.text: I want to show Elira the stairs when they're finished.

rest_after.speaker: tomas
rest_after.text: You can. The paper's waiting safely at home.
